> [!NOTE]
> **What this PR changes:**
>
> - Nine headings on the AWS API Gateway guide were retitled to sentence case.
> - The "define APIs" bullet list was relabeled with task-style link text ("Handling requests with Lambda" for "Lambda Function Event Handler Route").
> - The duplicate `awsx-apigateway-validation-types` example under "Request parameter validation" was replaced with prose pointing back at the earlier copy.
> - The `aws_proxy` integration bullet was rewritten to describe it as Lambda proxy integration specifically.
> - Assorted wording swaps: "easier" to "higher-level", "Amazon Lambda Functions" to "AWS Lambda functions", "Amazon Web Application Firewall (WAF)" to "AWS WAF", "Content Distribution Network" to "content delivery network".
>
> A reader is blocked here if a retitled heading breaks an in-page anchor, or if a rewritten sentence now describes AWS behavior that isn't real. Both were checked: every renamed heading was matched against the links that point at it, the claims the new wording makes were verified against AWS documentation, and the example program the new cross-reference relies on was read.
>
